headline: Carmila will integrate IGD's shopping centres in Italy
summary: Carmila will integrate IGD's shopping centres in Italy, adding a total of 25 assets valued at 1.9 billion euros. Italy will become its second-largest market by volume of activity.
why: Carmila is a French owner and operator of shopping centres, and such portfolio deals reshape the property and retail real estate sector.
